llm_summary: The Aestura Atobarrier365 Cream is generally highly regarded as a positive, "holy grail" staple for repairing damaged skin barriers and providing deep hydration for dry, sensitive skin types. While users praise its effective, ceramide-rich formula for soothing irritation and preventing dryness, some report mixed experiences regarding recent formula changes involving niacinamide. Additionally, a few users have noted that the texture can occasionally feel slightly greasy, despite its lightweight appearance.
